div.head: II Cn 73.2
div.ab: ⁊ þeah heo nydnumen weorðe, þolige þæra æhta, butan heo fram þam ceorle wylle eft ham ongean ⁊ næfre heo eft his ne weorðe.
⁊ þeah heo nydnumen weorðe, þolige þara ehta, buton heo fram ceorle wille eft ham ongean ⁊ næfre eft heo his ne wurðe.
Et licet etiam per uim capiatur, perdat tamen totam pecuniam, nisi nunc ab eo recedere uelit in domum suam et nunquam deinceps fiat uxor eius.
⁊ ðeah heo neadnumen wyrðe, ðolie ðæra æhta, buton heo fram ðam ceorle wille eft ham ongean ⁊ næfre eft his [no] wyrðe.
And although she has been married by force, she shall lose her possessions, unless she is willing to leave the man and return home and never afterwards be his.
And even if she was married by force, she is to forfeit those possessions, unless she wishes to leave the husband and return home and never afterwards become his.
Und selbst wenn sie mit Zwang zur Frau genommen wird, verliere sie die Güter [erster Ehe], wenn sie nicht von dem [zweiten] Manne wieder zurück heim will und niemals späterhin die Seine wird.
And even if she is taken as wife by force, let her lose the goods [of the first marriage], unless she wishes to go back home again from the [second] man and never afterwards becomes his.
